verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust web/UI framework (CLI, Axum server, components, rendering), not a data-holding application, so surfacing AI-generated insights from a user's data inside the product does not fit this kind of product. The AI-related evidence (AGENTS.md scaffolding, llms-full.txt, Markdown docs routes) is agent-facing documentation, a different capability that does not make this axis applicable.
